input_planes.restriction: An external PDF is measurable only when a runtime source map resolves its portable locator to a same-volume file with the frozen SHA-256.
A text-projection result never qualifies PDF ingestion, image interpretation, table structure, page geometry, or another omitted rich-capture surface.
Only a checked-in recipe that names the source spans, preserved conclusions, required deltas, and comparison complement may claim a reviewed relation.

relations.eligibility: the exact source authority and all required local providers are available
relations.required_relation: two isolated runs are exact after declared scratch-root substitution and normalization of proof digests cryptographically derived from that root

relations.eligibility: one byte-identical PDF is copied to two hash-verified adversarial repository-local locators
relations.required_relation: content capture and every semantic decision are invariant after declared document-identity and path normalization

relations.eligibility: the baseline has at least one downstream semantic record and a bijective source-bound symbol catalog with complete occurrence coverage
relations.required_relation: inverse-renaming the transformed artifacts yields exact canonical decisions and exact proof topology

relations.eligibility: a reviewed recipe exhaustively declares changed source spans and preserved conclusions
relations.required_relation: declared conclusions, residual accounting, and their complete unaffected complement remain equivalent

relations.eligibility: a reviewed recipe declares a syntax-preserving heading, whitespace, table, or formatting change and its exact parser boundary
relations.required_relation: all semantic conclusions and residuals are invariant while only declared presentation records change

relations.eligibility: a reviewed recipe declares one meaning-changing mutation, its required changed fact or residual, and the complete unaffected complement
relations.required_relation: the required semantic or residual delta occurs, the unaffected complement remains equivalent, and an invariant-only comparator rejects the run

held_out_policy.prospective_definition: Every current retained document absent from the reviewed-current overlap at the selection boundary is prospectively held out from behavioral recipe calibration.
held_out_policy.historical_reviewed_status: The 12-document reviewed dataset is evaluation authority but is not claimed historically unseen because its labels informed prior remediation.
held_out_policy.novel_vendor_definition: A prospective document is vendor-novel when its vendor is absent from reviewed calibration rows.
held_out_policy.novel_family_definition: A prospective document is family-novel when its family is absent from reviewed calibration rows.
held_out_policy.category_limit: The prospective population covers four categories. Missing prospective register-ip and cpu-isa denominators are unmeasurable, not passed.
held_out_policy.leakage_rule: Production core cannot read this contract, transform recipes, held-out membership, expected relations, thresholds, or outcomes.

held_out_execution.uncertainty_scope: Descriptive for the frozen non-random prospective population only; unavailable or invalid attempts are excluded from the interval but remain explicit in its denominator record.
